title: Box 4.02 The histopathological spectrum of neoplasia in Werner syndrome (WS): a summary of reports of 255 neoplasms in 196 patients with WS (73% Japan-resident, with added reports from patients in a diversity of additional locations), updated through March 2019 {23573208}
